title: How can I stop a black outline from showing over my BAN displays on my dashboard when a mouse hovers over them while keeping tooltip functionality?
content: I wanted to document this solution in the Forum as no one to my knowledge has posted this tip yet that I just learned at TC25 and that I could immediately use on dashboards I'm currently working on.The problem is this.  You have a perfectly good BAN dashboard view set up and you are utilizing some tooltips as a way to get more information into the view without cluttering it up, but when you start hovering that mouse around, you have big BAN boxes lighting up with a black outline.Looks like this to start:Looks like this as soon as you hover:What is happening starts from your worksheet you are displaying.  You notice that your BAN you created looks exactly like you want it to look and when you check the Marks card, you see that the software has used Automatic for the display type, and it has chosen TEXT:The result looks as it should, but when you put that mouse in there, the CELL lights up with a Black Box, and this behavior carries over to the Dashboard.Here is the Speed Tip that may Blow Your Mind if you are not already familiar with this. Change the Mark Type to a Shape! Shapes Change the way the highlight box is displayed. The outline of the Cell is no longer what is highlighted, but the actual Shape is highlighted.Note a default shape is chosen, and it's right in the middle of your BAN, and that probably isn't the outcome you wanted either, so the rest of the tip involves a couple of more steps.  Simply shrinking the size of the shape helps a lot, but you still have something visible.  You have 2 options here, and the first is the easiest.Option 1: Set the color of the shape to the same color as your background while keeping the size to a minimum.
